Who We Are HRP uses research to develop methods to protect the health and performance of astronauts in space. Learn About HRP View Our Hazards HRP has identified five hazards of human spaceflight: space radiation, isolation and confinement, distance from Earth, gravity (or lack thereof), and hostile or closed environments. Learn About the Five Hazards Human Research Roadmap The Human Research Roadmap provides an overview of the risks and knowledge gaps that HRP associates with human spaceflight.
